protocol.split_rule: Union claims' cited/positive document IDs; one component per source group. Even first SHA256 byte of group ID is development; odd is held_out. Select first20 queries per role by SHA256(query:id).
protocol.corpus_rule: Include all positive documents for selected queries, then SHA256(document:id)-ordered distractors to200. No metric/model-based sampling.
protocol.random_vectors: Independent seeded Gaussian unit vectors for each chunk and query; 384 dimensions; no text semantics.
protocol.lexical: Production PostgreSQL simple tsvector / websearch_to_tsquery / ts_rank_cd, no held-out tuning. Conjunctive query semantics may underfill; report coverage.
protocol.development_rule: Freeze minimum relevance as maximum development random/full-text nDCG@5. Choose smallest ef_search achieving development raw ANN recall>=0.95 across all declared filters; otherwise fail.
protocol.held_out_rule: Real model must exceed each control's held-out nDCG@5 and the frozen development minimum. No retry or selection based on held-out scores.
protocol.ann_raw: Disable exact underfill fallback only for ANN measurements; production default still uses exact fallback. Compare chunk neighbors against exact SQL, independently of relevance qrels.
protocol.limits: Bounded source-group subset, not the complete SciFact benchmark or evidence of uncontaminated model pretraining. Query splits are operator-held-out public data, not the original benchmark test split.
